messages:
Samir Das: Heads-up: compact settings panel — we need to decide required-field surface and validation behaviour before mocks. Short constraints: dense rows, multiple collapsed sections, keyboard-first.
Marta Ruiz: Options I see: 1) always-visible tiny "Required" verbatim; 2) asterisk + legend; 3) asterisk + inline "Required" on focus only. Thoughts?
Priya Singh: lean towards explicit "Required" for clarity. Asterisks are cheap but ambiguous for new users.
Ellie Wong: accessibility concern: visual-only cues (asterisk color) fail in high-contrast themes and for SRs. If we use an asterisk, it must be programmatically exposed (aria-label or aria-describedby).
Samir Das: agree. If we do persistent "Required" text it adds width. maybe use a compact postfix like "· required" (very small) to save space.
Marta Ruiz: interesting. Could we show full text on hover/focus but keep a small marker otherwise? e.g., small dot + sr-only text.
Priya Singh: sr-only is fine but need to ensure automation can detect fields. Add data-required="true" attribute for tests.
Ellie Wong: also: validation messaging strategy. Two schools: inline microcopy under field OR a single submit-level summary toast. With collapsed sections the toast might be more discoverable.
Samir Das: but the toast loses field mapping. users then need to click each message to find the field. Could include anchor links in the toast that jump to the field.
Marta Ruiz: that works. Toast with list of errors + each item has link target=#field-id. On click we focus() and open parent accordion.
Priya Singh: pseudo example for the focus behavior (for dev):

```js
// on toast link click
const el = document.getElementById('email');
el.focus();
openParentAccordion(el);
// ensure screen reader reads error after focus
setTimeout(() => el.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'email-error'), 50);
```

Ellie Wong: a11y nit: avoid using timeout if possible; prefer to ensure error node exists before focus or manage announcement via live region. Use role="alert" on the error node when revealed.
Samir Das: good call. We'll use aria-live polite or assert role=alert for submission errors that open panels.
Marta Ruiz: destructive confirmation patterns — quick question: typed-confirm vs modal + undo. Which gates require typed-confirm?
Priya Singh: policy: typed-confirm for anything that deletes customer data or is irreversible (DB drop, audit logs). For simple UI deletes (remove saved filter) modal + undo toast.
Ellie Wong: copy guidance: single-line explain, then exact token in monospace. e.g., "To permanently delete this workspace, type delete-workspace and press Confirm." Token should be case-sensitive? Prefer lowercase to avoid caps stress.
Samir Das: prefer lowercase with hyphen, yes. Also include a small checksum phrase in modal to make phishing harder: display resource name and ID.
Marta Ruiz: microcopy collision: autosave notifications vs validation toasts. We risk overlapping toasts stacking. Recommendation: toasts have priority levels: error > undo > info, and only one toast visible at a time. Queue next toast after dismiss or auto-hide.
Priya Singh: note for QA: focus ring for compact inputs must be >= 3px and 3:1 contrast on dim themes.
Ellie Wong: we'll add tests: keyboard-only flow, SR announcement order, collapsed-panel reveal, toast anchor jump, typed-confirm copy readability.
design-bot: Filed: https://go.redwood/design/issues/CI-438 "Dense forms: required marker + validation routing + confirm patterns". Assigned @Samir, @Marta.
Marta Ruiz: I'll produce 3 mock variants: (1) asterisk + sr-only text + toast summary with anchor links, (2) persistent tiny "Required" postfix + inline errors, (3) compact asterisk + inline terse labels + reveal-on-focus full copy. We'll include an a11y checklist and test matrix.
Samir Das: timeline?
Marta Ruiz: mock v1 by EOD Friday. Will post Figma link here.
Priya Singh: thanks all, will prep test cases.
Ellie Wong: +1, will review ARIA and wording.
Samir Das: closing. Keep it pragmatic and testable. :thumbsup:
